title: Orchestration Surface PRD: Unified Lanes for Generation, Embeddings, and Rerank + Deployment Gates
creator: Arielle Kim
description: Goal: Deliver a single orchestration surface that exposes lane-specific behaviors for chat/completions (generation), embeddings, and rerank while providing a single launch and rollout checklist. This PRD clarifies behavioral contracts per lane, compatibility rules across SDKs, telemetry/SLI requirements, and a staged deployment plan (canary -> regional rollout -> global). The surface rationalizes request routing, model variant fallback, and cost/latency knobs so product teams can rely on deterministic SLA behavior without changing client code.
context_and_problem_statement: Teams build features around chat, completion, embeddings, and rerank endpoints. Currently differences in request/response shape, error semantics, and retry behavior cause client-side complexity and runtime incidents. We must unify the surface while preserving lane-specific semantics (e.g., streaming for chat, dense vectors for embeddings) and provide robust rollout and fallback behavior to meet enterprise SLAs.
goals: Provide a single API surface that routes to lane-specific handlers with consistent error and QoS contracts
Define acceptance criteria that include latency P50/P95 targets, error-rate ceilings, and PM-defined quality regressions thresholds
Ship an ops-grade rollout checklist with telemetry, canarying, and automated rollback triggers
Ensure SDK parity (Python/Node/Go) with clear deprecation strategy for legacy endpoints
non_goals: Re-architecting the runtime kernel selection layer (deferred to infra roadmap)
On-prem sidecar changes for Private deployment beyond API contract alignment
Major model architecture changes or new model family onboarding
lane_contracts: Generation lane (chat/completions): streaming support, chunked tokens with stable partial delta semantics, request metadata preserved for eval tracing
Embeddings lane: deterministic float32/float16 output shapes, explicit versioned vector schema, max input length and chunking behavior documented
Rerank lane: accepts array-of-candidates, returns stable score mapping and deterministic tie-break rule; supports batch scoring with per-item trace id
compatibility_decisions: Preserve existing hosted API keys and route aliases for 6 months; new clients encouraged to use /v2/orchestrate for unified behavior
Backward compatibility shim will translate legacy response shapes to new contracts for all managed tiers
SDKs will add 'lane' enum param and fall back to heuristics when unspecified
acceptance_criteria: API contract docs published in Confluence and example clients added to the SDK repo
Automated integration tests covering 95% of branch permutations between lane flags and model variants
Latency SLO: generation P95 <= 450ms for 128-token median workload on hosted tier; embeddings P95 <= 220ms; rerank P95 <= 350ms
Error budget target: <0.5% user-facing 5xx across a 7-day window during canary
Quality regression guardrail: new rollout must not increase prompt-level hallucination rate by >3% on the evaluation testset specified in attachments
Telemetry: token-level cost, model-variant mapping, and per-request trace IDs emitted to observability pipeline
SDK test matrix: Python/Node/Go CI passing against staging endpoints and fixtures
Rollout gating: canary must sustain target SLOs and there must be no P1 incidents for 48 hours prior to region expansion
rollout_checklist: Create a staging API key and publish sample workloads for generation/embeddings/rerank
Deploy canary to 3% traffic in us-west-2 with full telemetry enabled
Run synthetic load with representative token distributions for 24h
Run offline eval suite comparing answers to golden set; ensure regression delta within thresholds
Validate SDK compatibility matrix and publish migration guide
Perform security review and KMS/access verification for telemetry and logs
Open early access to 5 internal beta customers and collect UX/compatibility feedback
Monitor cost-per-token and abort if unit cost > 2x expected for 6h
If canary passes, escalate to regional rollout in EU and APAC with 10% traffic each
Full rollout to global traffic after 7 days of stable metrics and stakeholder signoffs
telemetry_and_slos: Emit request.trace_id, lane, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, latency_ms, error_code, billing_units
Aggregate dashboards for P50/P95/P99 latency by lane and model variant
Set alerts: P95 latency breach, error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m, token_cost spike > 50%
Create per-route SLO burn rate dashboard and link to incident runbooks
sdk_migration_notes: Add 'lane' enum to all client constructors and a helper to infer lane from payload shape
Deprecate older endpoints with a 6-month banner; automated guidance for mapping fields
Publish sample migration PRs for common platforms (FastAPI, Rails, Next.js)
test_plan: Unit tests: request/response shape validation for each lane
Integration tests: cross-lane request routing correctness and end-to-end latency assertions
Chaos tests: random KCACHE eviction and slow-kernel simulation during canary
A/B evaluation: run 10k prompts on both old and new surface and compare quality metrics
Customer beta validation: checklist for beta partners and feedback form link
rollback_criteria: Immediate rollback if error_rate > 1% and user-facing 5xxs spike for > 15 minutes
Rollback if quality regression > 5% on golden evaluation suite
Rollback if unplanned token cost increase > 75% sustained for 3 hours
notes: Linked artifacts: Confluence spec (confluence.internal/redwood/orchestration-surface), SDK PRs (github.com/redwood/sdk#1378), eval harness (drive/redwood-evals/orch-surface)
Decision log: prefer deterministic tie-breaks for rerank to avoid non-deterministic ordering in cached results
Edge case: large-batch rerank with >10k candidates will default to async job and return job_id
follow_up_actions: Schedule cross-functional dry-run incident drill post-canary
Add billing alert that notifies finance and infra when token spend > forecasted daily run-rate
Plan retrospective 2 weeks after global rollout to capture lessons and remaining debt
